blocks.text: SM J Mall has unveiled its 2026 Christmas centerpiece, Kitsune’s Christmas Grove, featuring a 40-foot Christmas tree adorned with festive ornaments, floral accents, and lights alongside a white fox figure inspired by the kitsune of Japanese folklore. The display is accompanied by a season-long calendar of events running from October through December, including a fashion show, ikebana exhibit, live music, and a charity toy drive. A celebration of Japanese artistry, fashion, and holiday traditions SM J Mall Manager Eric Valenzuela said the kitsune character was chosen as a symbol of transformation and wishes coming to life, framing the holiday season around […]...
